terminalResult: Within finite-dimensional analytic or polynomial block-response germs, rank-changing Schur elimination is completely dispatched at value level by the cluster behavior of the full correction B D^-1 B^T: one finite value glues, multiple finite values remain approach-groupoid-valued, and an unbounded value retains/refuses the interior. No fixed finite jet decoration is uniformly complete, pole finite parts are scheme-relative, and positivity does not force descent.

findings.statement: Constant-support, range-compatible reciprocal Schur elimination preserves analytic Herglotz passivity and support-frame covariance.
For D_s=s^m(D_m+O(s)) and B_s=s^n(B_n+O(s)), the correction is classified by the sign of 2n-m.
The full correction is meromorphic for analytic one-parameter matrix germs; boundedness makes the puncture removable, including unequal-order non-diagonal crossings.
A singular-point response exists exactly when the approach-arc response functor is finite and constant on every admitted approach object.
For every fixed jet depth N, higher-contact paths with the same N-jet can have different finite Schur limits.
A nonlinear regular reparameterization changes the constant term obtained by subtracting a pole, so finite parts are not canonical without scheme decoration.
Smooth flat germs can share every Taylor coefficient while producing different finite corrections; the analytic theorem does not silently extend to jet-only smooth calculus.
Quadratic passive residue descends through sign holonomy; orientation/grading and invisible bulk index do not.
Positive operator-valued Herglotz measures represent passive branches but do not identify distinct approach-dependent residues.

finalDispatcher.condition: rank change and the full correction has one finite cluster value
rank change and finite cluster values depend on the approach arc
finalDispatcher.output: arc-groupoid-valued response; do not descend to one value

finalDispatcher.condition: the correction is unbounded along at least one admitted arc
finalDispatcher.output: retain the interior or refuse elimination

finalDispatcher.condition: a normal coordinate and subtraction prescription are explicit decorations
finalDispatcher.output: scheme-relative renormalized response with the scheme retained in its type

externalFrontiers.reentryCondition: Supply a representation of full smooth germs and a computable equivalence stronger than Taylor jets.
Declare a closed-range/Fredholm class, topology of convergence, and treatment of spectral accumulation.
Provide a concrete model, renormalized response construction and gauge/BRST compatibility obligations.
Specify the matrix fluctuation relation, state preparation and admissible nonreciprocal coupling class.

boundedExhaustion.scope: finite-dimensional analytic or polynomial block-response germs near a rank-changing locus
boundedExhaustion.qualification: Exhaustion is relative to the declared finite-dimensional analytic/polynomial value-level scope; external frontiers are preserved rather than erased.
